fields.Name: Finance Exceptions Ready To Close
fields.UserQuestion: Which company months still have open finance exceptions, and which are ready to close?
fields.Description: Open finance exceptions grouped by company and month of ExceptionDate, with the open amount and how many have been cleared. A month is ready to close when it has no Open exceptions.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Aggregates __mj_BizAppsAccounting.vwFinanceExceptions by CompanyID and DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(ExceptionDate), MONTH(ExceptionDate), 1). OpenCount / OpenAmount count Status = Open; ClearedCount counts Reviewed and Corrected; IsReadyToClose is 1 when OpenCount is 0. A company month with no exceptions has no row and is ready.
